newsitem.title: USA: SFX amends merger deal with Multi-Market.
newsitem.headline: SFX amends merger deal with Multi-Market.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc and Multi-Market Radio Inc said Thursday they amended their merger agreement to guarantee minimum payment of $12.50 a share to MMR holders.
The amendment provides that MMR shareholders will receive $12.50 per share of SFX stock, provided that SFX class A common stock trades between $44.00 and $32.00 during the valuation period.

At the current price level of SFX's class A common stock, which closed at $45.50 on October 2, the amendment will not increase the consideration received by MMR's common shareholders, but will ensure the $12.50 level should SFX's Class A Common Stock price decline prior to the valuation period established in the Merger Agreement.

Other than the guarantee of $12.50 per share in consideration for MMR shareholders, the agreement remains unchanged including the potential for increases in the consideration to be received by MMR shareholders to the extent that the SFX share price exceeds $44.00 during the valuation period.
The amendment to the merger agreement has been approved by the boards and the Independent Special Committees of each company.
